'''Koval Station''' was a transit [[Space station/Legends|space station]] orbiting [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] in the [[Chorios system|Nam Chorios system]].

==History==
This station in [[44 ABY]] served as a transit point for people that wanted to travel to the dangerous [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Nam Chorios and, more importantly, to supervise the embargo of the lethal [[Droch/Legends|droch]] that carried the [[Death Seed]] infection. It also controlled the departure of all [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from the planet to prevent the infection from leaving the planet. It was authorized to fire on any transgressors, and it replaced the old [[Bleak Point Station]] on the planet's surface.

==Appearances==
*''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'' {{Ab|Fate of the Jedi: Conviction (audiobook)}}
